description: Dollar-cost-averaging backtest using installed monthly closes, not live quotes. Asset ticker, start/end months YYYY-MM, initial deposit in USD, monthly in USD per purchase, frequency in months (1, 3 or 12), buying fee in percent, optional benchmark and total/price return basis. Initial deposit and first recurring purchase occur at the selected start month-end. Omitted dates use calculator defaults clamped to coverage. Returns data metadata and the free calc-dca PNG. Returns results, conditions, assumptions, an editable link, share page and PNG. No account access or order execution.

asset.description: Asset ticker. Available historical start dates vary by asset.

buyFee.description: Buying fee as a percentage, e.g. 0.1 means 0.1%.

end.description: End month, YYYY-MM. Must be within the installed data snapshot.

include_image.description: Also inline a PNG no wider than 1000 pixels. Image URL is always returned.

monthly.description: Contribution in dollars per chosen frequency (DCA), or per month (compound interest).

returnBasis.description: total reinvests distributions; price excludes distributions.
